competences.description: Attacks the enemy with condensed energy and reduces the enemy's Defense for 1 turn with a 50% chance. Twist Kick will be activated in succession with a 30% chance.

effets.description: Attacks an additional time on the same turn.
The target's Defense will be decreased by 70%.

competences.description: Attacks the target with a turning kick and decreases its Attack Bar by 50% with an 80% chance and decreases its Attack Speed for 2 turns. If the target's Attack Bar is depleted by this attack, the target will be stunned for 1 turn. [Light Dragon Attack] will be activated successively with a 20% chance.

Attacks the enemy target and randomly attacks 3 more times to remove 1 beneficial effect each. Each attack absorbs the enemy's Attack Bar by 20%. Counterattacks with a 25% chance when attacked on cooldown.

effets.description: Steal ATB from the enemy and add it to yourself
When attacked, the target will counterattack to inflict 75% of the Attack Power as damage.
